HR routes correctly enforce read-only — no POST/PATCH/DELETE/PUT decorators on /hr/training-records or /hr/safety-documents in hr_portal.py, and no write peers on /hr/driver-qualification* in employee_lifecycle.py (verified via source-level locks).
HrTrainingRecords.jsx exposes proper data-testid hooks (hr-train-counts, hr-train-source-pills, hr-train-source-pill-*, hr-train-table, hr-train-empty) — testability is solid.

Driver qualification dashboard returns 0 items in preview because preview DB has 0 employees with CDL/medical card/approved-driver signals — endpoint behavior is correct, this is preview data limitation only (confirmed by problem statement).

rca of the issue: Pre-existing P0 defect: /api/hr/training-records only queried training_track_records, dropping all safety_training_records (root cause #1). No employee linkage standard existed, so records with mismatched employee_id were silently dropped (root cause #2). No HR-namespaced safety_documents endpoint (root cause #3). Mitigation in iter350: UNION query in hr_portal.py (lines 750-870), new lib/employee_linkage.py utility with 4-tier resolver (id → master_id → name+email → name), new /api/hr/safety-documents read endpoints, read-only contract verified at the wire (POST/PATCH/DELETE all return 404/405/401). 17-test regression suite locks the fix in place.
